name: Sharpay Rauser
source:
A literal pencil sharpener, hallucinated into corporality by Manson. She plans to marry him and then "consummate" the marriage.

Returns as a minor role in the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony where she has sex with [Spoiler]Father and Sylvester.[/spoiler]
